tasks.subject: B4.1: Playwright navigation gateway (schedule fetch), egress opt-in fixture
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Extract navigate_and_trigger_schedule behind a gateway calling assert_egress_allowed, landing NET-WIRE-002, preserving DOM name discovery and the full schedule envelope. Adds a scoped test-fixture opt-in so the egress check doesn't break every existing ACQ-* test (all of which use non-loopback scoutingevent.com URLs).

**Files:**
- Create: `src/scoutmb/ports/scoutevent.py`, `src/scoutmb/adapters/scoutevent/playwright_gateway.py`, `tests/characterization/conftest.py`
- Modify: `scout_schedule_cli.py`
- Test: `tests/unit/scoutevent/test_playwright_gateway.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Egress check runs before page.goto; blocked host raises ExternalNetworkBlocked and never navigates
- [ ] ScheduleFetchResult carries the FULL envelope, attendee_id, and DOM-discovered display_name -- not stripped rows
- [ ] Playwright imported only under TYPE_CHECKING in the adapter, never at runtime module scope
- [ ] features/ports/core import zero Playwright symbols
- [ ] All ACQ-* process/raw/asset contexts pass unmodified (via the new opt-in fixture)

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/unit/scoutevent tests/parity/test_scoutevent_adapter_parity.py tests/characterization/test_acquisition_matrix.py tests/architecture -q` → PASS

See plan doc Task B4.1 for the corrected implementation.

tasks.subject: B5.3: Resumable checkpoints (immutable payload, ScoutmbError, strict type validation)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** CheckpointStore port + AtomicFileCheckpointStore, with a genuinely immutable Checkpoint.output_ids (MappingProxyType), CorruptCheckpoint(ScoutmbError), and load() validation rejecting every malformed shape (wrong types, bool-as-int version, invalid UTF-8), not just wrong version number.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/scoutmb/ports/checkpoint_store.py`, `src/scoutmb/adapters/files/checkpoint.py`
- Test: `tests/unit/acquisition/test_checkpointing.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] CorruptCheckpoint subclasses ScoutmbError
- [ ] output_ids is a real MappingProxyType, immutable even if caller mutates their source dict
- [ ] load() rejects: string completed_urls, list output_ids, non-string keys/values, bool version, invalid UTF-8, missing keys
- [ ] Save is atomic; a failed replace preserves prior bytes (explicitly tested)

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/unit/acquisition/test_checkpointing.py -q` → PASS

POST-CODEX FIX: this task had 3 critical bugs in the first draft -- CorruptCheckpoint didn't subclass ScoutmbError, output_ids was a plain mutable dict despite frozen=True, and load() didn't validate types (missing the exact bool-as-int hazard core/output_schemas.py already documents). All fixed. See plan doc Task B5.3.

tasks.subject: B5.5 (NEW): run_batch composes shared RetryPolicy + checkpoint + RunIdentity hydration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** features/acquisition/batch.py's run_batch() is the run-scoped composition Codex's review found missing entirely -- ONE RetryPolicy shared across all scouts (breaker is cross-scout, not per-scout), checkpoint skip/persist wired to a real loop, RunIdentity hydrate/snapshot added to core/identity.py. This is what scout_schedule_cli.async_main and troop349-schedule both call, so the orchestration logic lives in the package, not a flat module about to be deleted.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/scoutmb/features/acquisition/batch.py`
- Modify: `src/scoutmb/core/identity.py` (add snapshot()/hydrate())
- Test: `tests/integration/test_acquisition_batch.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Single RetryPolicy shared across every scout; breaker opens based on cross-scout consecutive failures, proven with a real 3-scout test where the 3rd is never attempted
- [ ] run_batch checks check_closed() before each scout, records failure/success ONCE per scout (not per retry attempt)
- [ ] A scout in checkpoint.completed_urls is skipped entirely (service.process never called)
- [ ] Checkpoint saved after each scout with updated completed_urls + run_identity.snapshot()
- [ ] A FRESH RunIdentity hydrated from a saved checkpoint returns the same output_id for a known attendee (simulates process restart, not same-instance reuse)

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/integration/test_acquisition_batch.py tests/unit/test_identity.py -q` → PASS

NEW TASK added post-Codex-review: the original plan claimed checkpoint/breaker composition happened in B5.4 but it never actually did -- ACQ-RESUME-* would have been reclassified to PRESERVE while testing nothing. This task is the real fix.
